text: For Epic 1 every one of the 14 data products is stamped by P1 rwb-source-data, which publishes GET /freshness and AceDataReady, and the owning service of each product is named later in its PRD.

read: Build Notes v6 Freshness; Arch v5 slide 15.
applied_in: Build Notes v7 Freshness and RWB-E1-015
impact: Names the owner of each product before wave 1 closes.

text: Each service gets one login named after its own service short name, set by the ACE DB stories of RWB-PLT-DB, and recovery_svc is retired at cutover.

read: Template and Rules R4 and DP-02; Build Notes v6 The grants.

text: For Epic 1 the V0002 and V0003 grant block is read as one grant per service login: P1 keeps SELECT on the 30 views and every other service holds no view privilege.

applied_in: Build Notes v7 The grants and RWB-E1-069
